✅ ②practiced: had + 과거분사 = 과거완료시제
❌ ①practice: 원형
❌ ③practicing: 진행형(had been ~ing 필요)
❌ ④to practicing: 문법 오류

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~③ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② interrupting → interrupted: 수동태(be + p.p.). 평화가 방해'받은' 것이므로 과거분사.
det.analysis:
❌ ②interrupting → interrupted: was + p.p. = 수동태
✅ ①smoothly: 동사 flowed를 수식하는 부사로 적절
✅ ③hanging: 현재분사(무기가 걸려있는 상태 = 능동)

questions.passage: Francis' heart raced; it was wartime, and soldiers often took ①<u>what</u> they wanted. ②<u>Whisper</u> urgently to his sister, Ellen, he led her to hide behind a tall tree, its thick trunk ③<u>shielding</u> them.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~③ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② Whisper → Whispering: 분사구문에서 주어(Francis)가 능동으로 속삭이는 것이므로 현재분사.
det.analysis:
❌ ②Whisper → Whispering: 분사구문은 ~ing 형태
✅ ①what: 관계대명사(they wanted의 목적어)
✅ ③shielding: 독립 분사구문(trunk이 주어, 능동)
det.tip: 분사구문: V-ing(능동), p.p.(수동) — 주어가 행위 주체이면 현재분사

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 동사 stepped을 수식하므로 부사 carefully가 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ carefully(부사): 동사 stepped 수식
❌ careful(형용사)
❌ caring(현재분사/형용사)
❌ care(명사/동사)
det.tip: 동사 수식 = 부사 (carefully, slowly, quietly 등)

questions.passage: Francis Pohan sat at the organ in his Borneo home, a smile on his face as the hymn he had practiced for weeks flowed smoothly under his fingers. The melody blended with the soft sounds of the jungle, filling him with happiness. The organ, his most precious possession, was a source of comfort and joy, especially in these uncertain times. But his peace was interrupted by the distant roar of engines breaking the calm. Soldiers appeared on the jungle road, their boots loud on the dirt as they approached, weapons hanging loosely over their shoulders. Francis' heart raced; it was wartime, and soldiers often took what they wanted. Whispering urgently to his sister, Ellen, he led her to hide behind a tall tree, its thick trunk shielding them. Peeking out, Francis stepped outside carefully and looked at the soldiers walking toward their home. Their loud voices and heavy footsteps filled the quiet jungle. His mind raced with prayers, hoping they would remain unseen.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 'the hymn he had practiced for weeks' → 몇 주간 연습한 찬송가를 연주.
det.analysis:
✅ ③: 원문에 'the hymn he had practiced for weeks' 명시
❌ ①: 몇 주간 연습했으므로 처음이 아님
❌ ②: 맞는 내용이나, ③이 더 정확
❌ ④: Ellen은 sister(누나/여동생)
❌ ⑤: hide(숨었다)

ch: 군인들이 정글 길에 나타나 평화를 깨뜨렸다.
Francis는 오르간을 몇 주간 연습한 찬송가를 연주했다.
